title: 2020 AMC 10A Problem 6
statement: How many \(4\)-digit positive integers (that is, integers between \(1000\) and \(9999,\) inclusive) having only even digits are divisible by \(5?\)

solutions.text: The last digit must be \(0\), because the number is divisible by \(5\) and all digits are even. The thousands digit can be \(2,4,6,\) or \(8\), and each of the hundreds and tens digits has \(5\) choices. Thus there are \(4\cdot5\cdot5=100\) such integers. Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: The last digit must be compatible with both evenness and divisibility by \(5\)
Choose the thousands, hundreds, and tens digits independently after fixing the last digit
